description: Propose new base stats for an owned entity with the human rarity/progressive reroll cost. Optionally lock up to two stats (x1.5 cost per lock). Full cost is reserved, half goes immediately to buyback. Inspect the pending proposal, then call forge_reroll_confirm (remaining cost to buyback) or forge_reroll_discard (human half refund, original balance provenance preserved). No energy.
name: forge_reroll
